decisions.reason: GA4 tracking is the required standard after Universal Analytics was retired, so the plugin meets current client demand and supports the firm's analytics offering above aspiration.
Google shut down Universal Analytics, so the plugin can no longer perform, and problemistic search points to moving its resources to GA4 and other offerings.
The retail system interface extends the firm's core interface and plugin competence, costs little to maintain, and its uncertain results can be carried with existing slack.
Relaunch SEO support fits tightly with the firm's shop relaunch and search marketing business and is prominently presented, indicating results at or above aspiration.
